description: Provision a Google Cloud Accesscontextmanager AccessContextManagerServicePerimeterResource via Config Connector. Fields mirror the accesscontextmanager.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1alpha1 AccessContextManagerServicePerimeterResource spec.

perimeterNameRef.description:
Only the `external` field is supported to configure the reference.

The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to. 
Referencing a resource name leads to recursive reference and Config Connector does not support the feature for now. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of an `AccessContextManagerServicePerimeter` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceRef.description: A GCP resource that is inside of the service perimeter. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `projects/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `number` field of a `Project` resource.
